description: This file defines methods for managing CSI block volumes in Kubernetes, including mounting, unmounting, staging, unstaging, and cleanup operations for block devices, as well as handling paths and device mappings.

classes.name: csiBlockMapper
classes.description: A struct implementing block volume mapping and unmapping for CSI driver in Kubernetes, managing paths, device setup, and cleanup.

methods.name: GetGlobalMapPath
methods.description: Returns the global device path for the volume on the node.

methods.name: GetStagingPath
methods.description: Returns the staging path for the volume.

methods.name: getPublishDir
methods.description: Returns the directory where the volume is published to each pod.

methods.name: getPublishPath
methods.description: Returns the specific publish path for the volume and pod.

methods.name: GetPodDeviceMapPath
methods.description: Returns the pod's device map path and filename.

methods.name: stageVolumeForBlock
methods.description: Stages a block volume to the staging path using CSI NodeStageVolume.

methods.name: publishVolumeForBlock
methods.description: Publishes a block volume to the publish path using CSI NodePublishVolume.

methods.name: SetUpDevice
methods.description: Ensures the device is attached and staged, returning the staging path.

methods.name: MapPodDevice
methods.description: Maps the volume to the pod, calling NodePublishVolume.

methods.name: unpublishVolumeForBlock
methods.description: Unpublishes the block volume from the publish path.

methods.name: unstageVolumeForBlock
methods.description: Unstages the block volume from the staging path.

methods.name: TearDownDevice
methods.description: Removes traces of the device setup, including unstaging and cleanup.

methods.name: cleanupOrphanDeviceFiles
methods.description: Removes orphaned device files and directories related to the volume.

methods.name: UnmapPodDevice
methods.description: Unmaps the device from the pod, calling NodeUnpublishVolume.
